top_signals.title: Trump sees Iran war ending soon after mid-term elections, predicts oil prices will then fall sharply
top_signals.summary: Oil prices retreated on Friday on hopes of a resumptions in negotiations, but notched sharp weekly gains after soaring above $100 a barrel.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Inflation is outpacing wage growth again, squeezing Americans’ paychecks
top_signals.summary: In August, consumer prices rose 3.4% over the past year while wages increased just 3.1%.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
